intents.name: cards
intents.answer:
💳 *Meridian Bank — Cards*

• *Debit Cards:* Free with savings accounts, contactless, with configurable daily limits via our app.
• *Credit Cards:* Travel, cashback, and secured (FD-backed) card variants available.
• *Activation:* Set your PIN at any Meridian ATM or activate instantly via the mobile app.
• *Lost/Stolen Card:* Block immediately in the app or call 1800 123 4567 (24x7).

intents.name: loans
intents.answer:
💰 *Meridian Bank — Loan Options*

• *Home Loans:* Up to 20% property value funding with tenures up to 30 years.
• *Personal Loans:* Quick sanction for salaried & self-employed; tenures up to 5 years.
• *Vehicle Loans:* Up to 90% on-road funding for new four-wheelers & two-wheelers.
• *Education Loans:* Collateral-free options available for premier institutes.

_Tap 'Check Eligibility' below to see if you qualify in under 1 minute!_

intents.name: check_eligibility
intents.answer:
👶 Minor Savings Account
Age: Below 18 years
- Guardian required for children below 10.
- Ages 10–17: self-operated account permitted, subject to bank approval.
- Minimum balance: ₹0.
- Documents: Birth certificate, child's KYC, guardian's KYC.
- On turning 18: Complete fresh KYC and account conversion formalities.












🏦 Regular Savings Account
Age: 18 years and above
- Minimum balance: ₹2,000.
- Interest rate: 3.00% p.a.
- Documents: PAN/Form 60, valid KYC documents, mobile number.
- Joint account facility available.












💼 Business Current Account
Eligible businesses and proprietors
- Minimum average balance: ₹10,000.
- Documents: PAN, owner KYC, business proof, address proof.
- GST certificate where applicable.
- No interest on the account balance in this sample policy.












🎓 Student Savings Account
Age: 18–25 years
- Minimum balance: ₹0.
- Documents: KYC, student ID, admission proof.
- Debit card with a sample daily withdrawal limit of ₹10,000.
- Applicants below 18 follow minor-account rules.












👴 Senior Citizen Fixed Deposit
Age: 60 years and above
- Minimum deposit: ₹10,000.
- Sample interest rate: 7.50% p.a. for a 1-year FD.
- Tenure: 7 days to 10 years.
- PAN and KYC required.
